name: Home services
description: For lawn care, pest control, heating and cooling, pool service, and chimney, gutter and window businesses: customers, their properties, visits on a board, seasonal and repeating service dates, and weekly routes on the calendar.

documentTemplates.name: Seasonal service reminder

helpTips.title: Seasonal dates
helpTips.body: For seasonal work like tune-ups, openings and gutter cleaning, enter the date you last did it. Pulse shows the next one when the season comes around.

helpTips.title: Weekly routes
helpTips.body: Put each route stop on the calendar as a weekly appointment. Pick a day for each area of town, and the calendar becomes your route sheet.

helpTips.title: Visits
helpTips.body: Move a visit to Done and Pulse fills in the date. Visits that are done or cancelled stop showing as due.

helpTips.title: Photos
helpTips.body: Drop before-and-after photos or signed work orders into Files on the visit. They are stored encrypted inside Pulse.
